objective: Remove Redis as a semantic configuration and data-source dependency
first_divergence: SQL production loader required disposable Redis copies of authoritative MySQL entities, indicators and source configuration
resolution: Read model-qualified active metadata and exact planned data sources from MySQL; keep a disposable five-second process cache; no Redis fallback

stale_test.reason: User-confirmed contract requires full rows plus attachment from SQL service; only final presentation limits preview to 20 rows

review: Exact positive model IDs and current request scope remain mandatory
MySQL reads restrict model, deletion, active entity/relation status and explicit domain before returning records
Missing explicit source never falls back to another source; ambiguous model sources are rejected
Expired process cache does not conceal MySQL outages; public errors omit connection details
Same-code assets remain isolated across models; cache refresh does not affect another model
No Milvus rebuild, semantic database mutation, conversation-state change or V2 routing change
